payout_quote: You can earn 1,000 points (worth $2 in savings) as a profile completion bonus the first time your profile is completed.
steps: Join Treats Rewards free (in store, online, or in the PetSmart app)
Complete your profile the first time: name, phone, email, text/email opt in-out, address, and pet information
1,000 bonus Treats Points (worth $2 in savings) are awarded one time only; redeem points for discounts on products or services
catches: Only $2 in PetSmart-only savings - small, but free for filling out a form
Points must be redeemed at PetSmart on products/services, not cash
Profile completion requires submitting text/email opt in-out selections and personal details
biggest_catch: Just $2 in PetSmart-only savings - only worth it if you already shop there or have a pet.
eligibility: Treats Rewards member; first-time profile completion
timing: Bonus points may take up to 72 hours to appear; ongoing earn (10 pts per $1) is separate and not counted.
